name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Sales & Partnerships Leader | Consultative Selling & AI-Native Systems
summary: Sales and partnerships leader with 15+ years exceeding revenue targets and closing complex commercial deals in B2B SaaS and local-business markets, most recently as founder of Solenzo, building an AI-driven business from the ground up. Comfortable navigating ambiguity, building new go-to-market motions, and engaging executive stakeholders as a trusted advisor. New to the Media & Entertainment advertising landscape specifically, but genuinely fluent in the AI systems reshaping how advertising and content discovery work, having built agent-based automation running in production.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, identifying opportunities to expand retainer scope and scoping complementary services aligned with client objectives.
Architect and deploy autonomous, AI-driven marketing systems, translating stakeholders' generalized ideas into precise, structured AI prompts and agent instructions.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals during tenure, averaging ~$22K each (several exceeding $25K), roughly $130K+ in total bookings.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps for effectively the full tenure, holding that ranking while quota roughly doubled over the period.
Closed deals of $20K and larger later in tenure, mixed with a base of smaller wins.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, building relationships with C-suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design.
Advised clients on CRM adoption, building scalable operational systems aligned to their growth stage and team structure.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
